finalText:
**Wrote 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Out of 380 commits, 11 things matter.

One breaking change. An expired token now returns `401`, not `403`. That was `fix(auth)` in `#4223`, not a `feat`, so it is easy to miss.

One new feature. Webhook retries with backoff. Nine fixes, deduped from the same fix landing in many modules.

Left out: four `perf` wins like `perf(api): reuse the parsed schema`. Your three headings have no home for them. Say the word and I add a `Performance` block.

Next: check if `engines` in `package.json` needs a Node bump. CI moved to Node 22 but only the docs said so.
